slug: 2026-07-08 FG Halts Enforcement of New Regulations on Internet Platforms

facts.fact: The communications minister directed on 7 July 2026 that new rules on internet platforms and other digital economy issues be deferred pending a unified national policy and governance framework, whose recommendations a joint committee is to develop.
facts.system: Unified national policy and governance framework (digital economy)

facts.fact: A joint technical coordination committee of NCC, NITDA and NDPC was established to coordinate stakeholder consultations and develop recommendations for the unified national policy framework; no finance is stated.
facts.system: Unified national policy and governance framework (digital economy)
